note: FH.4a endpoints from the call's shape. A generated REST SDK calls its runtime's own helpers (`lib.fetchJson('/users/me', { ...opts, method: 'PUT' })`, `lib.fetchText(path, lib.json({ method }))`): no extractor names the library, so no named-client rule matched and no ENDPOINT existed. The shape rule mints one for a path-shaped first argument plus a method signal (an options object's `method`, here also inside a one-call wrapper, or a `fetch*` callee, which defaults to GET); EVIDENCE rule `call_shape`. A Python script over a generated SDK (`api.call_api(f'/activities/{id}', method='DELETE')`) is the Python form. Baseline: see the FH.4a commit. Deliberately not bound to a matrix cell: typescript/http_client is already scored.
